title: Project Closeout Roadmap
summary: Diagnostic stack is complete. Closeout means promoting selected diagnostics to either (a) reviewer-actionable state or (b) decommissioning, plus one cycle of manual review.

items.name: Activity-Adjusted Review
items.purpose: Show how the top of the board would shift under a transparent activity overlay (liquidity / rel-vol / Pine accumulation / overextended). Now ships a top-25 entrants/drops section so the reviewer can spot promotion candidates without reading every row.
items.promotion_criteria: If the entrants list is consistently higher-quality than the current top-25 in manual review across at least 3 sessions, propose folding a small (≤±5%) version of the multiplier into production. Otherwise keep diagnostic-only.

items.name: External Benchmark Review + Disagreement Queue Review
items.purpose: Surface tickers where internal scoring disagrees with external benchmark sources; carry Pine and cool-off context; suggest keep/watchlist_only/ignore/needs_more_data per row. Now exports a CSV for offline review and a starter state template.
items.promotion_criteria: After one full review pass (state file no longer all-blank), measure: do reviewer 'ignore' decisions land on names that later confirm the internal view? If yes, keep diagnostic; if not, tune the gap thresholds in external_benchmark_review.py.

items.name: Pine Go/No-Go Diagnostic + Cool-off Cohort Tracking
items.purpose: Daily-OHLCV proxy of the Pine v6 gate stack; A/B cohort tracking of overextended_bb / clean_go forward returns.
items.promotion_criteria: Already production-quality as a gating overlay. Promotion is gated on the cool-off cohort showing a statistically meaningful spread over enough sessions (target: 20+ trading days).

items.name: Accumulation Signal Meter v1
items.purpose: Per-ticker accumulation-style score built from Pine OHLCV metrics (rel-vol, MFI, RSI zone, bar strength, near 20d high, close location). Diagnostic only; surfaces top/weak accumulation names and overlap with Pine clean-go and activity-adjusted top-25.
items.promotion_criteria: Track agreement between top-25 accumulation list and the eventual reviewer-confirmed names from the disagreement queue. If 60%+ overlap on confirmed-keep decisions over a month, consider adding as a small weighted input to ai_score (would require explicit user signoff).

sections.title: Manual review steps for the next session

items.action: Open the dashboard and click into Activity-adjusted. Compare the top-25 entrants and drops. Note any clearly-wrong activity-adjusted entries (e.g. earnings within 7d, low-quality momentum).

Open Disagreement review. Optionally download the CSV (link at the top of the report) and edit the starter template (data/reports/disagreement_review_state_template.csv) offline. For each severe row, decide keep / watchlist_only / ignore / needs_more_data.
Persist decisions: edit data/reports/disagreement_review_state.json (the canonical state) to record reviewed=true, decision, and notes for each reviewed entry. The next run will preserve those edits.

Open Accumulation meter. Cross-reference the top-25 with Pine clean-go and activity-adjusted top-25 (overlap sections are inline). Names that appear in all three are the highest-conviction diagnostic candidates.
Open Pine go/no-go and cool-off cohorts. Verify no new overextended_bb blockers on names you decided to keep.

items.name: Promotion vs decommission decision
items.description: Decide which diagnostic(s) should be folded into the production ai_score for the next iteration, and which to leave purely diagnostic. No production scoring changes have been made in the closeout batch.

items.name: Disagreement state import-from-CSV
items.description: Currently the CSV export is one-way (diagnostic → CSV). A reverse importer (CSV → state JSON) is intentionally not implemented to avoid silent overwrites. If wanted later, build it as an explicit standalone script that diffs against the existing JSON.

items.name: Accumulation meter validation
items.description: Component weights are picked by inspection, not optimization. Validate by backtest against forward returns before any promotion.

items.name: Workflow_dispatch trigger
items.description: All new reports are wired into update-rankings.yml. They will populate on the next scheduled run, or via a manual workflow_dispatch (user has explicitly chosen NOT to auto-trigger from this batch).

deploy_steps: 1. Review this branch's diff locally: `git log --oneline -5`
3. Push to main (already done by the agent if push succeeded).
4. Trigger the GitHub workflow manually when convenient — Actions → 'Update rankings' → Run workflow. This will re-generate all reports against fresh data and stamp tasks.json.
5. After the workflow run, refresh the dashboard; verify the three new report links (Activity-adjusted, Accumulation meter) and the new CSV link in the Disagreement review page.
